verdict.rationale: The docs.openclaw.ai/releases.md page appears to function as a changelog listing new features per release (plugins, teams, GPT Live, etc.), which is some evidence of versioned release notes, and 'openclaw security audit' can detect config drift. However there is no evidence of explicit migration notes for breaking changes, nor any documented rollback/repair path if an update breaks the install. missing for 10: migration/upgrade notes for breaking changes, a documented rollback or repair procedure, versioning scheme details, independent confirmation that updates are safe in practice.
